premises.text: 40% of food is wasted before it reaches consumers, creating a protein shortage problem.
premises.evidence_span: 1.4 billion tons of food is wasted every year, 40% before it's touched human hands.

premises.text: Converting pre-consumer food waste into protein offers a sustainable solution.
premises.evidence_span: if somehow we can convert pre-consumer food waste into protein, we can offer a sustainable solution for both problems.

premises.text: Natransa produces protein from edible insects by converting food waste into fertilizer.
premises.evidence_span: Natransa produces the next generation protein from a specific edible insect by converting food waste into fertilizer.

premises.text: The production system is more efficient than traditional protein sources.
premises.evidence_span: Our production system is exponentially more efficient than any protein sources.

premises.text: The insect-based protein has higher nutritional value than regular meat.
premises.evidence_span: Our product has two times more protein, 100 times more calcium, and four times more phosphorus than regular meat.

premises.text: The market for alternative protein sources is large and accessible.
premises.evidence_span: it's a $70 billion worth market, and easy to access due to low regulations.

premises.text: There is a growing demand for alternative protein sources due to dietary restrictions.
premises.evidence_span: there are renal and cancer patients who cannot digest regular meat and so they need other alternatives.

premises.text: Natransa's revenue model includes charging companies for food waste disposal and selling protein powder.
premises.evidence_span: Companies pay us to get rid of their food waste. So we get revenue by taking our raw material and by selling our insect-based protein powder and the fertilizer.

value.text: Natransa provides a sustainable and nutritious alternative protein source.
value.evidence_span: join the international movement to sustain the growing world population.

notes: Traction metrics and personal credentials excluded as they do not support premises.
